description: List the vote events on one of your listings, newest first: id, time, weight and whether it was voided. There are no addresses, account ids or player ids, so you can see that a vote counted double, not who cast it. Up to 500 at a time; when truncated is true, pass next_before_id as beforeId for the next page. Read-only. Submitting a listing for review is deliberately not available through MCP: it needs a human to pass the Turnstile check in the dashboard.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, only votes after it are returned
